A '''Director of Commerce''' was a person tasked with directing the economic activity in a certain location, particular a [[City/Legends|city]]. [[Sean Trenwell]] was the Director of Commerce for [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
